modules.name: Overdrive
modules.description: Tube-screamer style mid push. Great in front of a high-gain amp.

modules.name: Ember Fuzz
modules.description: Thick, saturated fuzz with a mid-scoop tone control.

modules.name: Clean Boost
modules.description: Clean gain with a tight low cut. Pushes the amp without changing its character.

modules.name: Compressor
modules.description: Evens out your picking and adds sustain.

modules.name: Glue Compressor
modules.description: Smooth bus compressor that glues the whole rig together.

modules.name: Lament Wah
modules.description: Wah: set it by hand, let it sweep by itself (Auto) or follow your picking (Envelope).

modules.name: NAM Pedal
modules.description: Load a .nam capture of any drive, fuzz or boost pedal.

modules.name: Ascend Whammy
modules.description: Bends your guitar up or down. Sweep Position like an expression pedal.

modules.name: Abyss Octave
modules.description: Adds an octave below, two octaves below and an octave above.

modules.name: Legion Harmonizer
modules.description: Two harmony voices that stay in key (it listens to the note you play).

modules.name: Richter Sub
modules.description: Earthquake sub-octave for huge low end.

modules.name: Photon Laser
modules.description: Every pick attack fires a falling resonant sweep: sci-fi lasers.

modules.name: Lethe Delay
modules.description: Digital, tape or ping-pong delay. Sync locks the repeats to the tempo.

modules.name: Crypt Reverb
modules.description: Deep, smooth room-to-cathedral reverb.

modules.name: Seraph Shimmer
modules.description: Reverb whose tail rises an octave (or a fifth): angelic pads.

modules.name: Aurora Swell
modules.description: Removes the pick attack and swells each note in, violin-style, into a soft reverb.

modules.name: Stasis Freeze
modules.description: Hold the button to freeze the sound into an endless pad, then play over it.

modules.name: Gravity Tape Stop
modules.description: Hold to slow the sound down to a stop like a tape machine losing power.

modules.name: Looper
modules.description: Tap REC to record, tap again to play, again to overdub. Up to 60 seconds.

modules.name: Shatter Glitch
modules.description: Tempo-synced stutters, reverses and half-speed drops. Hold to glitch, or let Auto surprise you.

modules.name: Tide Chorus
modules.description: Lush stereo chorus, from subtle shimmer to thick 80s.

modules.name: Vortex Flanger
modules.description: Jet-plane flanger with feedback.

modules.name: Prism Phaser
modules.description: Swirling 4 to 12-stage phaser.

modules.name: Pulse Tremolo
modules.description: Volume tremolo: smooth, triangle or choppy square. Stereo mode pans it.

modules.name: Spectre Mod
modules.description: Vibrato, rotary speaker or uni-vibe.

modules.name: Tesla Ring Mod
modules.description: Metallic, bell-like ring modulation with a wobbling carrier.

modules.name: Hex Bitcrusher
modules.description: Lo-fi bit and sample-rate reduction.

modules.name: Bloom Envelope Filter
modules.description: Auto-wah that opens with your picking: funky quack to synth sweeps.

modules.name: Sweep Filter
modules.description: Resonant filter with an LFO, free or synced to the tempo.

modules.name: Limiter
modules.description: Catches peaks so nothing ever clips. Put it last.

amps.name: GLASS 65
amps.description: Huge, glassy clean with lots of headroom. Bright-cap sparkle at low gain, scooped Fender mids.

amps.name: TOP 30
amps.description: Chimey class-A breakup. No negative feedback, so the top end jangles and the power amp compresses early.

amps.name: PLEXI 68
amps.description: Classic rock crunch from a non-master amp: open and punchy, with more gain from the power tubes as you turn up.

amps.name: BRIT 800
amps.description: The 80s rock and metal workhorse: cascaded preamp, tight mids, cutting top. Great with a boost in front.

amps.name: SLO 100
amps.description: Smooth, liquid saturation with a vocal midrange. Sings on leads and still stays tight on rhythm.

amps.name: STYX 51
amps.description: Aggressive modern metal: very tight low end, saturated upper mids. Made for down-tuned riffs.

amps.name: RECTO
amps.description: Thick, saggy, dark modern gain with a big low end. The rectifier sag makes palm mutes bloom.

amps.name: VH-4
amps.description: Precise, articulate modern German gain: dense, but every note in a chord stays clear.

amps.name: OBSIDIAN CORE
amps.description: Obsidian's own amp: tight like a 5150, smooth like an SLO, with a clearer top end.

amps.name: NAM Loader
amps.description: Load your own .nam captures, one per channel.
